## The claim

`scripts/changeset-polarity-census.mjs:216`. The instrument treats the word `without` as negating the WHOLE clause, when in the corpus it frequently negates only the phrase it introduces.

⇒ changesets are scored with the wrong polarity whenever `without` appears phrase-locally, and the census is the instrument other cards are judged against.

## What triage should settle

Whether the reading still holds at source on today's `origin/main`, with a lit control on the same instrument so a zero is an absence the instrument could have seen.
